clue.text: Jerk nabbing a disreputable fellow for trading

indicators.note: nabbing means seizing and holding, so the first word grips the second inside it

parts.note: a tic is a nervous jerk or twitch
raff is an old word for a low or disreputable person, as in riff-raff

explanation.surface: A twitchy man caught a shady character who was dealing in something illicit.
explanation.definitionFit: Traffic as a noun means commerce or dealing, often illicit, so it stands for trading.

clue.text: The best organised flier carries stamps

indicators.note: carries means holds within, so the bird holds the second word inside it

parts.note: a tit is a small bird, a flier
dies are tools that stamp designs on coins

explanation.surface: The best-run bird delivers postage.
explanation.definitionFit: The tidiest is the neatest and most orderly.

clue.text: A restriction put on leave

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition or restriction
to don clothes is to put them on

explanation.surface: Someone is restricted from taking time off.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon is to desert or leave behind.

clue.text: In the West Country, but originating in the East

parts.note: from means originating in, as in from Paris
E is the abbreviation for East

explanation.surface: Something now in south-west England actually came from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: The West Country is south-west England; FROME is a Somerset town.
explanation.definitionFit: Frome is a market town in Somerset, in south-west England.

clue.text: Breaking up cars is not for the bread!

indicators.note: breaking up shows the letters smashed and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Scrapping cars is not a way to earn money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bread' looks like slang for money, but it is the baked kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A croissant is a crescent-shaped French pastry roll, a kind of bread.

clue.text: Withdraws tick in cut-back

indicators.note: in places the word for tick inside the reversed word for cut
back in cut-back tells us the word for cut is read from the end

parts.note: to sever is to cut
a mo, like a tick, is a moment

explanation.surface: Someone pulls out a tick during a cut-back in spending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns SEVER into REVES, and 'in' places MO (a moment, like a tick) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove something is to take it away or withdraw it.

clue.text: Broadcast concerning the non professional

parts.note: re means about or concerning
lay means not belonging to a profession, amateur

explanation.surface: A programme about amateurs goes out.
explanation.definitionFit: To relay a programme is to transmit or broadcast it.

clue.text: A ship can glide by Her Majesty

parts.note: may, like can, expresses permission
to flow is to glide smoothly
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: A vessel may sail smoothly past the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mayflower was the ship that carried the Pilgrims to America in 1620.

clue.text: An old soldier-never at assembly

indicators.note: assembly means putting together, so these letters are assembled anew

explanation.surface: A retired soldier was never present at the meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A veteran is someone who served long in the armed forces.

clue.text: Watch a boy find the leak

parts.note: to see is to watch
a page is a boy servant

explanation.surface: A lad is told to keep an eye out and locate a leak.
explanation.definitionFit: Seepage is the slow escape of liquid, a leak.

clue.text: A devilish game!

parts.note: the game played with a spinning top on a string takes its name from the Italian word for devil

explanation.surface: A fiendish pastime is exclaimed over.
explanation.definitionFit: The juggling toy spun on a cord between two sticks has a name derived from the Italian for devil.

clue.text: Still to be seen in up-to date clothing for a youngster

indicators.note: to be seen in says one word appears inside another

parts.note: late can mean recent or up to date, as in the latest news
yet means still, as in yet more

explanation.surface: Some still-fashionable garment is on show in modern children's wear.
explanation.definitionFit: A layette is the complete set of clothes and bedding prepared for a newborn baby.

clue.text: Forever wanting a tip

definitions.meaning: read literally, lacking an end or tip

explanation.definitionFit: Perpetually means without stopping, and the word read literally describes something with no end, no tip.

clue.text: Grub is served for the French painter about five

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for the, standing for the French article

indicators.note: about here means round, so the painter surrounds the Roman five

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a painter
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: A painter serves food to someone in France while a group of five waits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts V inside RA to make RVA, after LA.
explanation.definitionFit: A grub is the larval stage of an insect.

clue.text: Dogma that could well be retrogressive

indicators.note: the word could be read backwards and come out the same, so going in reverse changes nothing

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A belief that might be backward-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or doctrine held as true, much like a dogma.

clue.text: Let no care corrupt the liberal spirit

indicators.note: corrupt means spoil or alter, so these letters are distorted into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning not to let indifference spoil open-mindedness.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolerance is a broad-minded attitude that accepts other views.

clue.text: Sum apportioned for building a wall once

indicators.note: building tells us the letters are put together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Money set aside to put up a wall at one time.
explanation.definitionFit: An allowance is a fixed amount of money allotted to someone.

clue.text: A picture of the head of state?

parts.note: land is a state or country, and of the land is the land's
a cape is a headland

explanation.surface: A portrait of a head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head of state' reads as LAND'S CAPE, a country's headland.
explanation.definitionFit: A landscape is a painting of rural scenery.

clue.text: Individual appearing in a T. shirt?

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless shirt like a vest or T-shirt
to be in a garment is to have it on

explanation.surface: Someone stands out wearing a T-shirt.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'with a singlet on'. A singleton is a single person or thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A singleton is a person on their own, a single one.

clue.text: Concession offered about room for a boat

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the first word goes round the second

parts.note: a sop is a concession made to appease
a hall is a large room

explanation.surface: A compromise gives space to moor a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A shallop is a light open boat.

clue.text: Managed to turn up before class and report

indicators.note: in a down entry turning up means reading the word from the bottom

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business
rate means class or grade, as in first-rate

explanation.surface: Someone arrives for a lesson in time to give an account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn up' turns RAN into NAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate is to tell or give an account.

clue.text: One just cannot see what's so entertaining

definitions.text: One just cannot see what's so entertaining

parts.words: One just cannot see what's so entertaining
parts.note: a medium of entertainment that is heard but not watched, so nothing is visible

explanation.definitionFit: Broadcast sound entertains listeners with no pictures at all.

clue.text: Takes a chance about love note, see?

indicators.note: about says the gambling word surrounds the letter for love

parts.note: to dice is to gamble, taking a chance
O is zero, love in tennis
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Someone gambles over a love letter and asks if you understand.
explanation.walkthrough: A see is a bishop's area of authority.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's see is the district he governs, his diocese.

clue.text: Striking found the guy totally friendless

parts.note: workers on strike are out
to found metal is to cast it

explanation.surface: A man on strike finds himself completely without friends.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcast is someone rejected by society, utterly alone.

clue.text: The person displaying a clothes-drier?

definitions.meaning: one who airs or shows off something
a rack on which washing is hung

explanation.definitionFit: One who airs views or goods displays them, and a household frame for washing dries clothes.

clue.text: Successfully completed the course-and fainted!

explanation.definitionFit: Graduates of a training college are said to finish their passing-out parade, and someone who swooned lost consciousness.

clue.text: The chaplain's swell with servicemen!

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, a link to the rest

parts.note: to pad is to swell out or fill
RE is the Royal Engineers, a body of soldiers

explanation.surface: The army padre is happy with his troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Padre is the services' name for a military priest.

clue.text: Remove bearings after a time

indicators.note: after places the compass points behind the time period

parts.note: an era is a period of time
S and E are compass bearings

explanation.surface: Take away bearings after an interval.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase is to rub out or remove.

clue.text: The Left won, being well informed

parts.note: to have earned something is to have won it

explanation.surface: The left-wing party won an election and proved itself knowledgeable.
explanation.definitionFit: A learned person is scholarly, having much knowledge.

clue.text: Promenade with a game American lawyer

parts.note: game can describe a lame leg, as in a game leg
DA is a District Attorney, a US prosecutor

explanation.surface: A walk taken with a sporting American attorney.
explanation.definitionFit: An alameda is a public walk lined with trees, a promenade, in Spanish-speaking places.

clue.text: Lead a number in deeper maybe

indicators.note: in puts the number inside the rearranged word
maybe signals the letters may be put another way

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral one hundred, a number

explanation.surface: A digit sits deeper in the line, perhaps at the front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges DEEPER to PREEDE, and 'in' places C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to come before something in order or time is to lead it.

clue.text: A high spot for the first mate and others

parts.note: in the Bible Eve was the first wife, Adam's mate
the rest means the others

explanation.surface: The first officer and the crew pick a lofty viewpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's tallest mountain is the highest place on Earth.
